children: Swaroop takes over the finance function after serving as Financial Controller for over 18 years

Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company has elevated Indu Swaroop as its Chief Financial Officer (CFO), following his tenure as the company's Financial Controller. The appointment was announced on November 12, 2026.

Swaroop has been associated with the insurer for more than 18 years and was part of its founding team. In his previous role as Financial Controller, he oversaw the company's financial controllership function and was involved in strengthening its financial governance, internal controls and finance operations.
During his tenure, he also contributed to key corporate developments, including the company's initial public offering (IPO).
In his new role, Swaroop will lead the finance function and work with the company's leadership team on financial management and governance.

Commenting on the appointment, Anuj Mathur, Managing Director and CEO of Canara HSBC Life Insurance, said Swaroop had been involved in the company's financial planning, reporting and capital management processes since its inception. He also highlighted Swaroop's role in the company's IPO and the development of its financial control framework.
Swaroop said he would focus on strengthening the company's financial foundations and supporting its next phase of growth, while working with the finance team and other business functions.
